artifacts.description: Comma-separated artifact paths to attach (used with `kind` done).

content.description: Message body, as the recipients will read it.

from_op.description: The op id this message belongs to (e.g. 'o3'). Ties a coord signal to a specific invocation when the sender agent runs multiple ops on the same branch.

kind.description: Message kind (default: 'message'). Use 'done' when you've finished your part and may be revived later, 'finished' when you're permanently done — quiescence detection reads this.

sender.description: Name to send as, so recipients know who is asking (defaults to '_cli'). A name that is not a member still sends, and is reported as a warning.

team.description: Team to send into — its id, its name, or an unambiguous id prefix.

to.description: Recipients: 'all' to broadcast to the whole team, or comma-separated member names.
